name: Baglioni Hotel Regina
positioning: Palazzo hotel on Via Veneto in Rome, with renovated contemporary rooms, the Primiera restaurant and bar, and the Aura Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Via Veneto base near Villa Borghese and the Spanish Steps
Families wanting connecting bedrooms or multi-bedroom suites
Guests travelling with a small or medium-sized pet

facts.text: The hotel has witnessed more than a century of Roman life.
The hotel is close to the gardens of Villa Borghese and the Galleria Borghese, Piazza di Spagna, Via dei Condotti and the Trevi Fountain.
Interiors use marble, alabaster, fine woods and boiserie, set within the nineteenth-century proportions of the palazzo.
Superior Room bathrooms are marble with Acqua di Parma amenities.
Superior Room stays include daily breakfast at the restaurant.
Superior Rooms come with a welcome bottle of wine and evening turn-down service.
Primiera is the hotel's restaurant and bar on Via Veneto, reinventing Italian and Roman culinary tradition.
Primiera's name comes from the winning hand in Italian card games.
Primiera has a wine list of Italian, French and international labels.
The Dolce Vita Suite has floors in black marble.
The 2-Bedroom Family Room has two connecting bedrooms and two marble bathrooms.
Small and medium-sized pets up to 15 kilos are welcome, with a supplement per stay.

highlights.text: The hotel sits on Via Veneto, the street made famous by Fellini's La Dolce Vita, a short walk from Harry's Bar.
The Roman Penthouse has a multi-level panoramic terrace with a Jacuzzi and a private gym.
Primiera is a project by the de Rosa family, built around traditional cooking with unexpected pairings.
Rooms have furnishings made to measure by Molteni&C and Rubelli curtains.
A gladiator school experience is offered for children, alongside a La Dolce Vita Vespa tour and a Fiat 500 vintage tour.

considerations.text: Hotel guests without a booked spa treatment pay a daily rate for access to the spa's wet area.
Aura Spa also welcomes external guests, not only hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
